name: Build: Procedural sky and image-based lighting
body: A procedural sky drawn behind the scene that also lights it: diffuse irradiance for ambient and a reflection for metals, replacing the flat sky/ground ambient pair. One PR based on nox-proto, with before/after screenshots, a guide page and a decision.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Built: sky-common.glsl, sky pass, analytic IBL in lit.frag, lantern::sky API, guide docs/sky-and-image-based-lighting.md, D-065. 202 of 202 tests pass on lavapipe. Metal and real-GPU timing unchecked.
